description: Two reviewed reports establish a June 26–29 tanker-driver sit-down strike and June 29 indoor government mediation, but do not establish a public assembly or participant count. The action is excluded on current body evidence under the codebook rule for labor negotiations until they become public events.
required_followup: If further coverage searches locate a public picket, rally or other gathering tied to the strike, assess its exact URL and determine simultaneous attendance and state-policy demand. Do not infer an assembly from strike participation or indoor meeting.
